title: extractor operation
description: Counter-current multistage liquid-liquid extraction column. Each stage is a liquid-liquid equilibrium split at the operating temperature, so the separation is a consequence of the declared activity model and not of an entered distribution coefficient — change the model and the answer moves, which is the point.

solvent.title: Solvent component
solvent.description: The component that identifies the extract phase. Naming it removes the ambiguity of which of the two liquids is which.

temperature.title: Operating temperature
temperature.description: Isothermal column temperature; defaults to the feed temperature.

hets.title: HETS (declared)
hets.description: Height equivalent to a theoretical stage, the case's own number: the column height is published as stages x HETS, a rating. Requires hetsSource; none is shipped.

hetsSource.title: HETS source
hetsSource.description: Where the declared HETS comes from (required with hets; a height is only as good as the number behind it).
